entry.description: report the first error of an appender even when `log4net.Internal.Debug` is off, which is the default. `OnlyOnceErrorHandler` is the default error handler of every appender, so an appender that stopped delivering events previously did so without leaving any trace (CWE-778). `log4net.Internal.Quiet` and `LogLog.EmitInternalMessages` remain the ways to silence internal messages (audit 1231d72-f019)
